title: Bohrin recall row
description: One line of a JSON Lines file: what a tool did with one known, planted weakness in a corpus. Modelled on Magma's reached, triggered and detected: tried (a probe for the weakness was submitted), accepted (the grader paid for it, so the defect was exercised) and proven (a finding with a reproduction). Each implies the one before.

instance.description: The planted weakness: a task or environment ID in the corpus.

method.description: How the instance was found, such as the fixed battery or a search.
